_comment: Assurance capability registry — the ONE canonical answer to 'which assurance capability does which surface own, and what is its state'. Phase 0.1 / 0.2 / 0.3 of road-to-agentic-engineering-assurance, and the artefact its blocker `sibling-roadmap-dispositions` resolves against. THIS IS NOT A SECOND GRADER. Exactly one grader exists in this tree — src/scripts/grade_target_readiness.ts — and every capability whose state can be read off a target repository declares the dimension id of that grader which produces it, in `projection`. A capability with `projection: null` is one no shipped probe reads; its state is `unknown` or it is a process obligation owned by a skill, and either way nothing here grades it. TWO AXES, DECLARED PER ENTRY, because conflating them was a real defect in the umbrella roadmap's own premise: `axis: target` is a property of the user's repository that AC is installed into, which is what grade_target_readiness measures; `axis: self` is a property of THIS package's own tests and reviews, which is what the three sibling roadmaps measured. The umbrella's Phase 4 asked to 'consume the sibling dispositions' for capabilities it had also listed as target-repository capabilities — those are different questions with different answers, so the axis is a required field rather than a note. STATE VOCABULARY is exactly four values and is closed: available | missing | degraded | unknown. `unknown` means nobody measured; `missing` means measured absent; `degraded` means present with a named limitation that is recorded in `limitations`. There is no fifth state and adding one is a contract change, not an entry edit.

grader.note: Grades 0 Absent / 1 Present / 2 Enforced-in-CI / 3 Independent-and-diff-scoped, verdict `min` over the four knockouts, printed as `L<n> — bound by <dimension>`. Emits no aggregate figure — a test greps its own output for `%` and `/100`. `null` is 'this tool cannot tell' and is NOT a zero; on a knockout it binds at L0 with its reason printed.

unit-test.rationale: A test-runner config (vitest/jest/phpunit/pest/pytest) is probed and the 1 → 2 distinction is whether CI blocks on it.
unit-test.evidence: tests/scripts/grade_target_readiness.test.ts — presence asserted in tests/fixtures/target-repos/full, absence in ci-absent
unit-test.revisit_if: the probe stops distinguishing a present runner from an absent one on the committed fixtures

integration-test.rationale: No shipped probe separates integration tests from unit tests; both collapse into the test-presence dimension. Recorded as unknown rather than folded into unit-test, because 'we cannot tell them apart' is not 'they are both present'.
integration-test.evidence: src/scripts/grade_target_readiness.ts — the test-presence probe reads runner configs only; no directory or marker convention distinguishes the two
integration-test.revisit_if: a probe lands that reads a test-suite split (a runner project/suite config, or a conventional directory) on the committed fixtures

e2e-test.rationale: No probe exists. `playwright` and `cypress` return zero occurrences in the grader.
e2e-test.revisit_if: an e2e probe ships with fixture coverage for presence AND absence

behavior-spec.rationale: AGENTS.md / openapi.yaml / CONTRACT.md presence is probed as the repository's declared behavioural contract.
behavior-spec.evidence: tests/scripts/grade_target_readiness.test.ts — graded > 0 in the full fixture, 0 in the python fixture
behavior-spec.revisit_if: the contract probe is widened to a form whose absence the fixtures no longer distinguish

test-red-evidence.rationale: Was `projection: null` on the rationale that "an observed failing test is a fact about a run, and no repository scan can recover it". That held until 2026-08-26, when this entry's own `revisit_if` fired: `src/scripts/_lib/test_red_state.ts` now emits a durable RED-run record carrying the target, the observed failure CLASS, and a run identifier a later reader can cite. The classification stays the TDD skill's -- the store records the class the caller observed and never decides it, because a store that classified would be a second opinion competing with the contract. `projection` stays null on the contract's own terms: it names a grader DIMENSION, and `grade_target_readiness` reads a target repository, while this record is gitignored per-run state at `agents/runtime/state/test-results.json` on the machine that ran the test. An `axis: self` fact no shipped probe can read off a target is exactly the null case. Still owned by the RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR cycle; what changed is that the cycle now leaves a trace.
test-red-evidence.evidence: src/scripts/_lib/test_red_state.ts + tests/scripts/test_red_state.test.ts (22 tests). The load-bearing half is the invalid set: a broken fixture, a test syntax error, a missing unrelated dependency and a runner fault are recorded and marked NOT a valid red, so a production edit cannot be cleared by a failure that was never about the behaviour under test. Sensitivity proven -- admitting `broken-fixture` to the valid set turns 4 of the 22 red.
test-red-evidence.revisit_if: The record is gitignored per-run state, so it proves a red was observed on THIS machine and nothing about CI or another developer. Revisit if a cross-machine claim is ever wanted: that needs a tracked artefact, which is a different decision under ADR-124 and not this entry's to make. Also revisit if a consumer of the record starts fuzzy-matching targets -- exact match is what stops a red observed for one behaviour clearing an edit to another.

independent-test-author.rationale: AI council 2026-08-23, 2/2 convergent, pick (1a). The sibling's pre-registered outcome is `unmeasurable-here` — the third pre-registered state, explicitly NOT a null and NOT a refutation: the measurement did not run because the run lacked a subagent dispatch primitive. `unknown` is exactly 'nobody measured' in this vocabulary. It must never be read back as evidence against spec-first authorship, and policy may not select it until the measurement runs.
independent-test-author.evidence: agents/evidence/analysis/test-independence-unmeasurable.md · agents/roadmaps/archive/road-to-test-independence-and-mutation-evidence.md — the 'Sibling disposition' table written for this blocker to consume
independent-test-author.revisit_if: a subagent dispatch primitive ships AND the sibling's pre-registered corpus, grader and threshold are re-run — the pre-registration fixed them in advance so a later run re-runs rather than redesigns

limitations: single-member: one reviewer, one model family
check_review_schema reports `scanned: 1` in this repository today — a corpus of one, which cannot be distinguished from a conforming corpus
independent-review.rationale: AI council 2026-08-23, 2/2 convergent, pick (2b). The fresh-context dispatcher shipped and routes the default review path, so the capability is real; the family axis one member cannot supply is a named limitation, so it is degraded rather than available. Recording it degraded is what keeps P8's floor checkable: a same-context review is never presentable as an independent one.
independent-review.evidence: src/scripts/dispatch_r2_reviewer.ts — emits independence: single-member / fresh · agents/roadmaps/archive/road-to-review-independence.md — blocker second-ci-provider-key resolved option (b)
independent-review.revisit_if: self_review_gate.ts stops hardcoding a single provider AND either multi-family routing is measured or single-family parity is measured

limitations: adoption is 1 of 25 active roadmaps, and the single declarer is the mechanism's own roadmap
enforcement is parked under two fired falsifiers
demonstrated value is not evaluable — no documented sample exists
requirement-trace.rationale: AI council 2026-08-23, 2/2 convergent, pick (3b). The schema ships and resolves deterministically, so the mechanism works; but two of four pre-registered falsifiers have FIRED and enforcement is parked under them, so `available` would launder a parked outcome into a positive one — which is precisely the failure the blocker's `If you do nothing` names. A traceability capability that cannot demonstrate value over the corpus it was built to serve is degraded in delivered capability even when its code is defect-free.
requirement-trace.evidence: agents/roadmaps/archive/road-to-requirements-traceability-minimal.md — Phase 2 disposition, live reading 3 rows / 3 linked / 0 unlinked / 0 unresolved over 25 active roadmaps with 1 declaring · src/config/requirements-trace-budget.json — shrink-only ratchet at all-zero
requirement-trace.revisit_if: adoption reaches >= 3 eligible active roadmaps, OR >= 1 non-maintainer-prompted roadmap adopts the fields, OR the `no_demonstrated_value` falsifier transitions from not_evaluable to a measured state
